tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every section.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, match cards and menus that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, zebra rows, inactive segments and input wells inside surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around panels. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (segmented control, inputs, quiet buttons) on surface and surface-raised; at least 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, team names, scores and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, column headers, league names, captions on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: rink
tokens.usage: The brand accent, named after the blue sports-hall floor: links, the active segment, focus rings, primary buttons. Text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-rink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rink fill (primary button, active segment).

tokens.name: rink-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the current row (followed team) and hovered menu cards; rink text stays legible on it.

tokens.name: ball
tokens.usage: Signal colour of the floorball itself: the Live badge, a goal marker on the momentum line, the playoff cut. Use as a fill with ink (light) or surface (dark) text on it, never as text colour.

tokens.name: ball-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the ball colour ("Live", "Today") on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Regulation wins in form guides and results; always paired with the letter W.

tokens.name: win-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a W form pill; win text reads on it.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Regulation losses; always paired with the letter L.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an L form pill; loss text reads on it.

tokens.name: otl
tokens.usage: Games decided in overtime or penalty shots (OTW, OTL, PS); always with its letters.

tokens.name: otl-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an overtime form pill; otl text reads on it.

tokens.name: crest-1
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (blue), white initials. Picked per team by a stable hash of the team name.

tokens.name: crest-2
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (teal), white initials.

tokens.name: crest-3
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (violet), white initials.

tokens.name: crest-4
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (red), white initials.

tokens.name: crest-5
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (amber), white initials.

tokens.name: crest-6
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (green), white initials.

tokens.name: crest-7
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (rose), white initials.

tokens.name: crest-8
tokens.usage: Team monogram fill (slate), white initials.

tokens.name: on-crest
tokens.usage: Initials on every crest fill (4.9:1 or more).

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Scoreboard digits only. Archivo widened (font-stretch 112%) with tabular figures.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page title of a team, league or player page. Condensed (font-stretch 75%).

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page. Condensed (font-stretch 80%).

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: The number in a stat tile. Tabular figures, normal width.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and match rows. Tabular figures so columns line up.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Thorengruppen won all six games so far.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Team names in tables and cards, dates, secondary lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase column headers, stat-tile labels and eyebrows. Always ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a crest and its label, between form pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and badges, between table cell content.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, match card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop, gap between grid tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, form pills, inputs, segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Match cards, stat tiles, menu cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Page-level panels and the scoreboard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, segmented control track, crests.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Only for things that float above the page: the league menu and search dialog. Panels have no shadow.
